name: mirage
text: The engine does list SharpAPI. Its check reads: Active and accepted, sharp tier, 1,000 requests a minute, up to 25 books, Pinnacle included. It's pushing odds over the stream (about 174,000 rows so far) and game state for 11 live games. The app only got the SharpAPI card in v1.0.42, so your installed version is probably older. Install v1.0.43 and pull to refresh: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.43 . If you're already on v1.0.43 and it's still missing, tell me which screen you're looking at.
